title_working: Which Room Would You Pick To Save Your Mom?
world_rule: Survive one year in a room

lines.text: Which room would you pick to save your mom?
lines.say: (sad) Which room would you pick to save your mom?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You have to survive one full year inside it.
lines.say: (nervous) You have to survive one full year inside it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Room one is freezing. No bed, no food, and every hour it gets colder.
lines.say: (nervous) Room one is freezing. No bed, no food, and every hour it gets colder.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And not one person will ever come to see you.
lines.say: (sad) And not one person will ever come to see you.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Room two is pitch black. You can hear your mom calling your name.
lines.say: (nervous) Room two is pitch black. You can hear your mom calling your name.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But no matter where you walk, you can never reach her.
lines.say: (sad) But no matter where you walk, you can never reach her.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Room three is perfect. Your dream bedroom, endless snacks and the biggest gaming setup ever.
lines.say: (happy) Room three is perfect. Your dream bedroom, endless snacks and the biggest gaming setup ever.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And your mom is right there with you, smiling.
lines.say: (soft tone) And your mom is right there with you, smiling.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But to pick room three, you have to subscribe and comment which room you chose.
lines.say: (happy) But to pick room three, you have to subscribe and comment which room you chose.
lines.speaker: narrator
